limits: Operating income: the company publishes this line as 'Operating profit'. It is used as the equivalent of 'Operating income'.

Capex basis: the cash-flow line 'Capital expenditures – excluding equipment leased to others' (2,821) is used. Including 'Expenditures for equipment leased to others' (1,465) gives 4,286 (Note 23). This changes free cash flow from 8,918 to 7,453. The analyst should confirm the intended definition.

Total financial debt: includes the MP&E finance lease item of 6 (Note 14), which is embedded in long-term debt and not separated on the balance sheet. The amount is immaterial. Operating lease liabilities (728, Note 20) are excluded as required.

Most of the debt (about 32.6 billion of 43.3 billion) belongs to Financial Products (Cat Financial). Consolidated net debt therefore reflects finance-subsidiary borrowings that fund receivables and is not a measure of industrial leverage. The report presents MP&E and Financial Products separately (pp. 51–53).
Cash excludes restricted cash and MP&E available-for-sale securities of 1,230, as the rules require.
